claims.claim: Q2 2026 revenue grew 48% to $22.974B, but that growth was driven by 60% higher volume and partially offset by a 13% decline in realized prices; the same quarter therefore provides direct evidence that pricing pressure can offset part of otherwise strong demand growth.

Mounjaro and Zepbound were the principal growth engines, while U.S. realized price declined 3% overall and would have declined about 9% excluding rebate/discount estimate adjustments; outside-U.S. realized price declined 36%, driven primarily by Mounjaro reimbursement-list entry in China. This source-addresses payer/reimbursement and product-concentration sensitivity without implying current deterioration.

Lilly committed another $4.5B to Indiana manufacturing while Q2 acquired IPR&D charges were $2.8B and acquisition/integration-related impairment, restructuring and special charges were $703M. These are execution and capital-allocation exposures for Alpha to quantify, not evidence by themselves of a financing or governance defect.

riskSupport.risk: Realized-price erosion can offset volume growth, especially where reimbursement expansion increases access at lower unit economics.
riskSupport.observedEvidence: Q2 2026 worldwide volume +60% versus realized prices -13%; outside-U.S. realized prices -36% with China reimbursement cited as the primary driver.
riskSupport.falsifierOrImprovementEvidence: Sustained volume growth with stable/improving realized price and margin, or demonstrated mix/cost offsets that preserve durable economics.

riskSupport.risk: Growth concentration in Mounjaro/Zepbound increases sensitivity to incretin competition, access and payer economics.
riskSupport.observedEvidence: Issuer states Q2 growth was driven primarily by Mounjaro and Zepbound; combined Q2 revenue was approximately $14.9B of $23.0B total revenue.
riskSupport.falsifierOrImprovementEvidence: Broader therapeutic-area contribution materially reduces dependence while incretin economics remain resilient.

riskSupport.risk: Large manufacturing and acquisition commitments create execution/capital-allocation exposure even while current earnings are strong.
riskSupport.observedEvidence: Additional $4.5B Indiana manufacturing commitment; $2.8B acquired IPR&D and $703M acquisition/integration-related special charges in Q2 2026.
riskSupport.falsifierOrImprovementEvidence: Capacity utilization, launch supply, acquired-pipeline conversion and returns on invested capital demonstrate that commitments translate into durable capability.

unknowns: Alpha must determine the numeric risk treatment and score impact; this assist does not set either.
The source does not by itself establish future realized-price trajectory, payer mix, or return on the new manufacturing/acquisition commitments.
